title: Decol SPAIS Event 1: What is Decolonising the Curriculum?

description: Still apprehensive of the buzzword ‘decolonising the curriculum’? Join Heidi Safia Mirza and Jason Arday, editors of the fantastic book ‘Dismantling Race in Higher Education: Racism, Whiteness and Decolonising the Academy’, for an eye-opening and deeply insightful event. Chaired by Professor Alvin Birdi, this event will disentangle what it means to truly ‘decolonise the curriculum’.
